scenario: You manage your company's sales team. Ethan joined your team four weeks ago, and this is his first sales job. His job is to call people who have shown interest in your company's service and get them to sign up. On his first day, your only advice was to get comfortable on the phone and make as many calls as he could. You haven't given him any other guidance since. Today is his first monthly check-in. He's keen and wants to do well. Help him plan his next month.
objectives: Ethan wants to double his calls next month. Agree with him what he should aim for.
A customer waited four days for Ethan to reply to her email. Agree with him how to handle customer emails.
Agree with Ethan how you'll both know whether it's working.
whoYouBody: You manage the sales team. You hired Ethan four weeks ago.
whoThemBody: A keen new sales rep in his first sales job. Calls people who have shown interest in the service and tries to get them to sign up.
entryCardBody: Help Ethan, a keen new sales rep, turn "more calls" into a clear plan for his next month.
